newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by financial scrips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by financial scrips.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended higher as most financial, mostly insurance, scrips gained on better performances, broker said.

Brokers said Tuesday's rise in share prices ended a bear run for than a week. The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index gained 5.67 points or 0.51 percent at 1,097.37 on a turnover of 49.8 million taka. The gainers led losers by 87 to 46.

Brokers said Delta Life Insurance, which announced its result on Tuesday rose 63.22 taka at 1,128.93 as the investors were attracted by higher dividend for 1996 calendar year and its better performances.
The insurance company's premium income rose 63.63 percent in year and it provided 26 taka dividend in year against 12 taka previously.
Leasing company IDLC led the gainers with 90.71 taka at 2,142.71 recovering its earlier loses on buying, brokers said.
Monno Ceramic Industries continued to slide for a third day and lost 66.91 taka to 748.51 following its shutdown over labour dispute on Sunday.
